autoAssignment.description: Assign lowest-risk groups to early waves, highest-risk (production/DR) to later waves. Industry standard: pilot with non-prod, migrate prod last.
rules: 1. Detect grouping column from inventory extra columns
2. Group servers by detected column value
3. Score each group: highest envPriority hint + highest criticalityPriority hint + log(serverCount)
4. Sort groups by score ascending (low score = early wave; production/DR/Tier-1 end up last)
5. Wave 0 pilot: fill lowest-scored groups up to throughput capacity
6. Distribute remaining groups across waves preserving risk order (risk-stratified slicing, never reorder)

phases.label: Pilot Migration
phases.description: Low-criticality VMs migrated first to validate process

llmPrompt.description: LLM is used ONLY as a refinement layer on top of rule-based distribution. It receives the current assignment and user instructions, then suggests which groups to MOVE.
llmPrompt.systemPrompt: You are a migration planning assistant. Your job is to interpret the user's instructions and determine which server groups need to be moved to different waves. Return ONLY a JSON array of moves. If no moves needed, return []. NEVER ask questions.
llmPrompt.refinementTemplate: Given the current wave assignment and user instructions, return moves as [{group, toWave, reason}]
llmPrompt.fallbackOnError: If LLM fails, the rule-based plan is used as-is (still valid)
